interfaces.name: airway
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: The ventilator must supply the patient through an airway with finite resistance and compliance, include inspiratory and expiratory flow actuation, and include a safety alarm that responds to over-pressure or persistent regulation error. Read patient_compliance, airway_resistance, leak_fraction, target_insp_pressure, obstruction_factor, and obstruction_time from base-workspace variables. Across the declared patient and leak range, airway pressure must be closed-loop regulated to the inspiratory target and PEEP, maintain physiologically directed patient flow and volume, respect a 35 cmH2O safety ceiling, and recover after the temporary obstruction. Log Timeseries airway, lung_state, circuit_flow, and actuator. airway must contain [airway pressure in cmH2O, patient-directed flow in L/s, lung volume above PEEP in L].

interfaces.name: lung_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log Timeseries airway, lung_state, circuit_flow, and actuator. lung_state must contain the alveolar pressure in cmH2O computed from the patient volume and compliance.

interfaces.name: circuit_flow
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log Timeseries airway, lung_state, circuit_flow, and actuator. circuit_flow must contain [ventilator delivered flow in L/s, circuit leak flow in L/s] measured at the downstream circuit junction, so that delivered flow supplies the patient branch and leak branch.

interfaces.name: actuator
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log Timeseries airway, lung_state, circuit_flow, and actuator. actuator must contain [inspiratory-valve command, expiratory-valve command, alarm state].
